entry.title: Add published per-token pricing for Ollama Cloud models (#7108)
entry.content:
Add published per-token pricing for Ollama Cloud models (#7108)

* Add published per-token pricing for Ollama Cloud models

Ollama publishes per-1M-token rates on each model's library page
(e.g. https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3) but the ollama-cloud
provider entries carried no cost data, so consumers computing spend
from this catalog (opencode, ccusage, etc.) report /bin/zsh.00 for these
models.

Adds [cost] blocks to the 16 models with published rates, sourced
from each model's library page on 2026-09-14. Cross-checked against
opencode-go entries for every overlapping model (glm-5.2, glm-5.3,
kimi-k3, kimi-k2.6, minimax-m2.7, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4.1-flash)
and against the zai first-party entries for the GLM family — all match.

DeepSeek models bill Base (off-peak) and Peak (2x) rates; the schema's
cost tiers only express context-based pricing, so the Base rate is
authored with a top-of-file comment noting the Peak multiplier.

Models with no published price (gpt-oss, gemma4, qwen3.5,
nemotron-3-super, nemotron-3-nano) and retired models (kimi-k2.5,
minimax-m2.5) are left without cost, matching the AGENTS.md guidance
for request-only / no public price entries.

* Add pricing for the 6 remaining served Ollama Cloud models

Completes the cost pass for every model Ollama's cloud API serves:
gemma4:31b, gpt-oss:120b, gpt-oss:20b, nemotron-3-super,
nemotron-3-nano:30b, and qwen3.5:397b. Also cites the canonical
https://ollama.com/pricing page in every leading header instead of
per-model library pages, and references issue #5913 on the DeepSeek
entries, whose Base/Peak rates the cost schema cannot yet express.
